subject: Global Maritime Logistics Symposium 2026 Submission Forms Are NOW OPEN!
body:
[image: Maritime.png]

Hello Hackers!

The moment you've been waiting for is here: submissions for Maritime x Maritime Council
Symposium 2026 are OPEN! 🎉

Your team has made it this far. Now it’s time to show us what you’ve built.
📝 Submit Your Project

Ready to showcase your solution? Head over to the *submission form*
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCQhQtxsp6J1vMzayBDNzYIpZD-cN-YD2DB1dUbHPAep0RlA/viewform?usp=header>
and submit your project before the deadline: 22 September 2026, 12:00 p.m.
💡 Submission Checklist

Before hitting submit, make sure your team has prepared everything required
by the submission form.

✅ Your submission should include:

   - Team details
   - Project details, including your project name and description.
   - GitHub/GitLab repository with a clear README.md
   - 5-minute pitching video hosted on YouTube (Public or Unlisted only) or
   uploaded to Google Drive.
   - Live Prototype/Demo Link of your deployed project.Slide
   deck/Documentation covering your Technical Architecture, Implementation
   Details, Challenges Faced, and Future Roadmap.

✅ Your project should also:


   - Meaningfully incorporate AI into its core functionality, development,
   or deployment
   -

   Utilize cloud infrastructure
   -

   Have at least a low-code, semi-working prototype

Pure no-code submissions are not accepted.

Please refer to the Rules and Regulations
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/10PZgxtw4qvDg19NESDZPXt2oc6pSYsj9DKoKOY8PvdI/edit?usp=sharing>
for the complete submission requirements.
🎯 Important Notes

Submit Early
You can edit your submission anytime before the deadline, so you don’t need
to wait until everything is perfect.

Test Your Prototype
Run through your demo before submitting. Make sure the core functionality
works and your setup instructions are clear.

Keep Your Repository Clean
Your README should clearly explain what your project does, how to set it
up, and how to use it. Make it easy for the judges to understand your
project.

Keep Your Pitch Within 5 Minutes
Your pitching video must not exceed 5 minutes. Exceeding the limit will
result in a 1-mark deduction for every additional 30 seconds.
🏆 What Happens Next?

After submissions close:

   -

   24 September: Finalists Announcement
   -

   26 September: Final Pitch Day

If your team is selected as a finalist, you’ll present your project live
for 15 minutes total: 10 minutes for your pitch and demonstration, followed
by 5 minutes of Q&A with the judges.
📚 Need Help?

*👾 *Discord <https://discord.gg/RZ729TdZGf> For questions about the
submission process, competition rules, or technical requirements, head over
to #faq or #create-a-ticket on Discord.

📖 Info Pack
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YrnEANXCxypIKwONAr6QrcLnVW35FtwR66sJn_8M5dc/edit?usp=sharing>

🤞 Good Luck!

Best Regards,


Aaron Chin

Secretary

*Google Developer Groups on Campus (GDGoC) Maritime Logistics Council*
